description: Scrambles a signal through a sixteen value shift register: on each clock either the input or a value already in the register is read in, decided by three comparators

params.text: Picks which stored value the first comparator looks at, position 0 to 15
Picks which stored value the second comparator looks at, position 0 to 15
Picks which stored value the third comparator looks at, position 0 to 15
The voltage the first comparator compares against; it reads true when the stored value is at or above this, where the README writes the test as less than
The voltage the second comparator compares against; it reads true when the stored value is at or above this, where the README writes the test as less than
The voltage the third comparator compares against; it reads true when the stored value is at or above this, where the README writes the test as less than
Picks which stored value is read back in when the comparators come out false, position 0 to 15
Picks which stored value the Out jack carries, position 0 to 15
Mod leaves the choice of what is read in to the comparators; SR always reads back the oldest stored value, which makes the register loop; Seq always reads in the In signal

inputs.text: Each rising edge reads one value into the register and shifts the rest along by one place
A rising edge clears all sixteen stored values to 0V and blocks the clock for 1ms
The signal offered to the register; it is read in whenever the comparators come out true
Sets the position the first comparator looks at, 1.6 positions per volt, and overrides the Pos1 knob while patched
Sets the position the second comparator looks at, 1.6 positions per volt, and overrides the Pos2 knob while patched
Sets the position the third comparator looks at, 1.6 positions per volt, and overrides the Pos3 knob while patched
Sets the first comparison voltage and overrides the Cmp1 knob while patched
Sets the second comparison voltage and overrides the Cmp2 knob while patched
Sets the third comparison voltage and overrides the Cmp3 knob while patched
Sets the position that is read back in, one position per volt, and overrides the PosR knob while patched
Sets the position the Out jack carries, one position per volt, and overrides the PosO knob while patched
Sets the mode, Mod below 5V, SR at 5V and Seq at 10V, and overrides the mode switch while patched

outputs.text: The stored value at the position set by the PosO knob
All sixteen stored values at once, the oldest on the first channel and the most recent on the sixteenth

menu: Cmp Range — the span of the three comparison knobs: -10V to 10V, -5V to 5V, -3V to 3V, -2V to 2V, -1V to 1V, or 0V up to 10V, 5V, 3V, 2V or 1V, starting at -10V to 10V
Invers 1 — turns the first comparator's result around, so it reads true below its comparison voltage
Invers 2 — turns the second comparator's result around, so it reads true below its comparison voltage
Invers 3 — turns the third comparator's result around, so it reads true below its comparison voltage

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
